sharedRules.name: Trailfinder
sharedRules.description: After both sides are deployed, starting with Player B, each player may choose one of their units with the Trailfinder make a Free Walk Action with it. This does not count as the unit's Activation. Trailfinder selection and movement alternates and continues until all units with Trailfinder have been moved once.

sharedRules.name: Unstoppable
sharedRules.description: This model may make Ram Actions even though it does not have the VEHICLE Trait. Furthermore, the unit ignores the Heavy quality for any weapons it carries.

sharedRules.name: Tough
sharedRules.description: The unit may re-roll failed Grit Checks. As always, you may never re­roll a re-roll. Furthermore, this unit does not count as being Wounded by a failed Grit Check and instead is Stunned (even if not normally able to be Stunned). If the unit is already Stunned or the hit is caused by a weapon with a Piercing of-4 or greater it is Wounded as normal.

sharedRules.name: Sure Foot
sharedRules.description: The unit ignores the penalty for Uneven Ground and may re-roll Quick based checks.

sharedRules.name: Unique
sharedRules.description: A player cannot field multiple units that share the same unique name. If the unit has a different name, but is the same individual, the card will specify who it counts as for Unique purposes.

sharedRules.name: Mettle
sharedRules.description: This unit does not count as being Wounded by a failed Grit Check and instead is Disordered (even if not normally able to be Disordered). If the unit is already Disordered or the hit is caused 17,- a weapon with a Piercing of -4 or greater it cannot use the Mettle Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: The Quick and the Dead
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, unless Hunkered, this unit may declare they will use this rule against an enemy model's Combat Action that declares them as the Initial Target (but before dice are rolled). This unit must make a Quick Check. Should they pass the Quick Check, all hits from that model's Action against this unit are ignored and this unit becomes Hunkered. If this unit fails the Quick Check, then they are hit as normal. You may not use this rule against hits using Blast or Torrent templates.

sharedRules.name: Largesse
sharedRules.description: This unit may allow a unit from their Posse to spend Fortune Chips from this unit as though they were their own.

sharedRules.name: Target Priority
sharedRules.description: This unit may only be targeted by a Shoot Action if they are the closest enemy unit in Line of Sight or if they are within 12" and Line of Sight.

sharedRules.name: Agile
sharedRules.description: The model passes Quick Checks for climbing and jumping automatically and may re-roll failed Grit Checks from falling.

sharedRules.name: Deadeyed
sharedRules.description: Against units of multiple models, this model's Aim Check may target any one model in the enemy unit within Line of Sight as the Initial Target. The unit may target units with the Target Priority rule, even if they are more than  12" away (subject to range and Line of Sight as normal).

sharedRules.name: Durable
sharedRules.description: The unit may ignore the first point of Piercing from an attack. However, if the hit is caused by a weapon with a Piercing of -4 or greater then Durable has no effect.

sharedRules.name: Elite
sharedRules.description: The unit may choose to count the Guts bonus provided by Adventure Cards played during their Activation as being + 1 Action Point instead of the actual bonus printed on the cards. Units with the ELITE skill automatically pass YELLER checks.

sharedRules.name: Prodigious
sharedRules.description: This unit gains +3 (or +3" where applicable) for Focused Actions rather than the usual +2.

sharedRules.name: Reanimated
sharedRules.description: The unit is always Disordered and has a Limit of 1. Each time the unit receives a Negative Condition one model in the unit must immediately pass a Grit Check or suffer a Wound. This unit cannot be affected by Carpathogen or any other rule that would enable it to return to play (or become a Hex Beast) once destroyed.

sharedRules.name: Skirmishers
sharedRules.description: The unit has a Unit Coherency of 4".

sharedRules.name: Tasked
sharedRules.description: All models in the unit must target the same enemy unit in an Action. If the target is destroyed the remaining models lose their Action. This unit can only make Focused Actions if within 12" of a friendly unit with the BOSS Trait.

sharedRules.name: Teamwork
sharedRules.description: Should a Face or Boss in this Posse finish Activating within 8" of this unit, you may immediately Activate this unit as though an Triggered Activation has occurred. This counts as this unit's Activation for the turn. This unit cannot use Teamwork if it has already Activated this turn.

sharedRules.name: Moving Target
sharedRules.description: Provided this unit has made a Move Action of at least 7" this turn, successful Aim Checks against this unit must be re-rolled.

sharedRules.name: Shrouded
sharedRules.description: Successful Aim Checks against this unit must be re-rolled.

sharedRules.name: Unarmed
sharedRules.description: Unarmed units do not even have the basic Melee Weapon that units usually carry. Units with the Unarmed rule confer a +2 modifier to Grit Checks to enemy models against Melee attacks this unit makes. This unit's Melee range counts as base contact.

sharedRules.name: Displace
sharedRules.description: When an enemy model in a unit is hit by this weapon in an Action, the enemy model scatters d5" in a random direction (remembering the Path of Least Resistance of course). The unit gains the Disordered Condition if the model scatters out of Unit Coherency. Models in the unit cannot be placed out of the Play Area, into Impassable terrain or within a building Of model with capacity. Models within a building or within a model with capacity cannot be Displaced.

sharedRules.name: Parry
sharedRules.description: The weapon or shield is designed for deflecting enemy attacks.  A model with this weapon or shield forces a single successful hit per Strike Action to be re-rolled.  Models with the VEHICLE Trait or the Reanimated Common Rule may not Parry.

sharedRules.name: Ammo Clip
sharedRules.description: Each hit from a weapon with this quality may gain one of the following additional qualities for the duration of that hit: Brutal, Disrupt, Shred or Stun.

sharedRules.name: Attuned
sharedRules.description: During any Focused Combat Action this unit may give all Attuned weapons it carries a Piercing equal to half the wielding model's Mind Attribute. Example: Legendary Walks looking has a Mind Attribute of 7. She spends an Action point to make her Strike Action Focused, giving her Spirit Blades a Piercing of -4 (half of her Mind attribute).

sharedRules.name: Beacon
sharedRules.description: The weapon acts as a homing device for friendly models in reserve. Should the weapon hit an enemy unit, then any friendly unit held in Reserve gains+ 1 to their Reserves O,ecks. A unit successfully using this bonus must deplC7f as close as possible to the targeted enemy unit

sharedRules.name: Blast
sharedRules.description: This type of weapon uses the Blast template when determining hits, centred on the Initial Target. If the model fails their Aim Check when using this weapon, it is assumed the shot is a dud and has failed to detonate. Should any model be successfully hit by the weapon then any models touched by the template are automatically hit. When used in a Free Shoot Action, a Blast weapon does not use the template and instead causes d5 hits on the target (with a maximum of one hit per model).

sharedRules.name: Brutal
sharedRules.description: After resolving one or more successful hits on the target unit with this weapon, resolve a further single automatic hit on the same unit. You may only gain a single additional hit from this weapon in each Action.

sharedRules.name: Close Work
sharedRules.description: This Ranged Weapon may be used as a Melee Weapon in a Strike Action using the model's Fight Attribute rather than using Aim. If used as a Melee Weapon, then for the remainder of the turn the weapon has a Melee range of 2" and when used in a Strike Action it suffers a -3 penalty to the Fight Check.

sharedRules.name: Complex
sharedRules.description: A model using this weapon suffers a -2 penalty to any Aim or Fight Check. If this weapon has the Indirect quality, it cannot spend + 1 Action Point to ignore the Indirect quality.

sharedRules.name: Decapitate
sharedRules.description: When an S, M or L target is hit by an Action made with this weapon, the hit becomes Lethal. If the hit is already Lethal it becomes Brutal as well. MACHINE, SPIRIT or STRUCTURE models are unaffected by Decapitate and so the benefit is not conferred.

sharedRules.name: Disorder
sharedRules.description: If the Initial Target fails a Grit Check by a hit from this weapon, in addition to being Wounded, the unit gains the Disordered Condition. SPIRIT or STRUCTURE models are unaffected by Disorder. If the unit is already Disordered, the hit gains the Lethal quality instead.

sharedRules.name: Disrupt
sharedRules.description: Any MACHINE or CONSTRUCT model hit bythis weapon gains the Sb.Inned and Disordered Condition, even though it might not normally be able to do so. If the unit is already Sb.Inned and/or Disordered, the hit gains the lethal quality instead.

sharedRules.name: Drag
sharedRules.description: When a model with this weapon successfully hits an enemy modeL the enemy model gains the Disordered Condition and is moved dS" towards this model (remembering the Path of least Resistance of course). Models in the target unit cannot be Embarked, dragged out of the Play Area or into Impassable terrain.

sharedRules.name: Lethal
sharedRules.description: Successful Grit Checks must be re-rolled against hits from this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Linked
sharedRules.description: Combat Actions using this weapon may re-roll failed Aim or Fight Checks.

sharedRules.name: Overcharged
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this quality gains the Disrupt and Hazardous qualities for the duration of that Action. If the weapon already has both of those qualities it gains the lethal quality as well.

sharedRules.name: Engulf
sharedRules.description: Hits using a Torrent or Blast weapon with this quality ignore Obscured bonuses to Grit Checks. If an Initial Target in a building is hit by this weapon, every model occupying the same level of that building are automatically hit as well.

sharedRules.name: Hazardous
sharedRules.description: A model hit by a weapon with this quality immediately becomes affected by the Hazard Condition. If the unit is already affected by a Hazard Condition, the hit becomes lethal instead.

sharedRules.name: Portal Weapon
sharedRules.description: The weapon may be used as nonnal for its type. It is assumed that the Portals it emits are very small and designed to cause vortex damage to a target rather than create a fully functioning Portal. Alternatively, the weapon may be used to make a Manipulate Portal Action.

sharedRules.name: Heavy
sharedRules.description: Unless carried by a MACHINE, the weapon can only be used in a Combat Action if the unit does not make a Move or Charge Action during that Activation.

sharedRules.name: Refined
sharedRules.description: Actions made with this weapon score a Critical Success on a natural roll of a 9 or a 10.

sharedRules.name: Indirect
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this quality does not require Line of Sight to its target and ignores Obsrured penalties. Make an Aim Check as normal. lft he Check fails, the shot is assumed to go wide and not cause any effect on the game. If the Check is passed, place the centre of the Blast template over the intended target and then the template scatters d5+ 1 inches in a random direction. Any models touched by the template are automatically hit. Use the centre of the template for determining direction for calculating Obscured bonuses to Grit Checks. A model may spend an additional + 1 Action Point to ignore this quality when using this weapon in a Shoot Action.

sharedRules.name: Revolver Fan
sharedRules.description: Once per Activation, the unit may spend an Action Point and double its Rate of Attack with this weapon in a Shoot Action. During that Shoot Action the model receives a -2 penalty to their Aim Attribute. When using the Revolver Fan quality, the weapon cannot score a Critical Success.

sharedRules.name: Shred
sharedRules.description: Attacks using this weapon ignore the Obscured modifiers to Grit or Aim conferred from the first piece of terrain in its path. Should there be further terrain pieces which can confer Obsrured bonuses, then these are applied as normal.

sharedRules.name: Smokescreen
sharedRules.description: This weapon may be targeted at the ground instead of at an enemy unit. Should the weapon successfully hit, place a Blast template at the point targeted. The template remains in place until the end of the turn. While in play, the template is considered Area Terrain and any model touching the template receives the Shrouded Common Rule and suffers from the Disordered Condition. Furthermore, the template counts as an XL sized piece of Area Terrain providing an Obscured bonus as normal.

sharedRules.name: Special
sharedRules.description: This weapon may only be used by the model once per turn.

sharedRules.name: Stun
sharedRules.description: If a non-VEHICLE or CONSTRUCT Initial Target passes a Grit Check by a hit from this weapon, the target model gains the Stunned Condition. If the model hit is already Stunned then the hit gains the Lethal quality.

sharedRules.name: Tangle
sharedRules.description: In addition to passing a Grit Check as normal, a unit hit by a Tangle weapon must pass a Fight Check. If it passes, the unit suffers no additional effect If the unit fails, the unit immediately receives the Stunned and Disordered Conditions. Units with the SPIRITTrait are immune to Tangle.

sharedRules.name: Thrown
sharedRules.description: Once per Activation the weapon may be used as a Ranged Weapon with an s• range with the Rate of Attack indicated.

sharedRules.name: Torrent
sharedRules.description: Use the tear shaped Torrent template with this weapon. The narrow end is placed flat touching any point of the edge of the attacker's base, with the centreline touching the initial target of the shoot action. If the Initial Target is not hit by the attack, it is assumed the weapon has failed to fire. Should the Initial Target be successfully hit then all models touched by the template are automatically hit. This does not include the firing model! Models that have their Line of Sight completely blocked from the original attacker by terrain can still be affected by the torrent but cannot be the Initial Target When used in a Free Shoot Action, a Torrent weapon does not use the template and instead causes d5 hits on the target (with a maximum of one hit per model).

sharedRules.name: Suicide
sharedRules.description: If a model uses a weapon with this quality, the model is removed from play once the Action is resolved. If the weapon uses a template, and there are multiple models potentially hit, the hit must be resolved before any other models in the unit may shoot.

sharedRules.name: Rapid
sharedRules.description: This unit can Focus Move Actions for no additional cost.

sharedRules.name: Dark Council
sharedRules.description:
For two Action Points this unit may select a unit with the TAINTED Trait (friend or foe) within 8". That targeted unit must make a Mind Check with a -1 modifier. If the Check is passed nothing happens. If tile Check fails the selected unit is Compelled and must  immediately make an Action of this unit's choice. The Action counts as a Free Action, cannot be Focused 
or use Fortune and for the duration of this Action, the Compelled unit counts  as friendly to this unit. Furthermore. you may deploy a single Hexallth during deployment for each unit with this rule in your army.

sharedRules.name: Savant
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when Activated, the unit may spend two Action Points for its owning player to select and examine a random card in their opponent's hand of Adventure cards. The chosen card must be discarded and a new one drawn to replace it.

sharedRules.name: Enervate
sharedRules.description: For one Action Point this unit may select an enemy unit in Line of Sight within 12". The targeted unit must make a Mind Check. If the Check is passed, nothing happens.  If the Check fails, the selected unit immediately loses d5 Fortunte Chips.

sharedRules.name: Spectral Summoning
sharedRules.description: A unit in Reserve the Spirit Trait may spend a Fortune Point during its Activation to immediately pass its Reserve Check. The summoned unit must be deployed in base contact with a model with this rule and is available to Activate as normal this tum. If the model with this rule is a Boss unit, then Support units in that Boss' Posse withi the Spirit Trait may be placed in Reserve.

sharedRules.name: Sawbones
sharedRules.description: Any friendly unit (excluding this unit) within 3" gain the Tough common rule.  Sawbones has no effect on MACHINE, ARTEFACT or STRUCTURE units.

sharedRules.name: Carpathogen
sharedRules.description: This ability costs a Fortune Chip and may be used by this unit once per turn when a CONSTRUCT Face, Hands or Support unit is destroyed within 6" of this unit.  Immediately, before Taint Checks are made, d5 of the CONSTRUCT models from the destroyed unit are returned to the Play Area within 3" of this unit.  Any model that cannot be placed does not return and is removed from play.  The returned CONSTRUCT unit counts as having Activated for the turn and has the Reanimated rule.  Carpathogen cannot be used against units that are removed from play due to Yeller Checks.

sharedRules.name: Stone Cold Killer
sharedRules.description: Any time this unit destroys an enemy model, it receives an addiotnal Action Point for this Activation.  The unit's Action Limit still applies.

sharedRules.name: Gunfighter
sharedRules.description: This unit may target different units with Checks from their weapons Rate of Attack in a Shoot Action rather than having to resolve them against a single target unit.  The unit does not need to spend an Action Point to use the Revolver Fan quality.

sharedRules.name: Elusive
sharedRules.description: Backstab Reactions against this unit suffer a -4 penalty.

sharedRules.name: Form Up On Me
sharedRules.description: After both sides have deployed, this unit and a Hands unit within 3" gain the Trailfinder Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: Head Hunter
sharedRules.description: When this unit destroys an enemy model that has the Unique Special Rule, this unit immediately gains a Fortune Chip.

sharedRules.name: Rapport
sharedRules.description: This unit's army may always include an additional Civilians Strategic unit for the appropriate points cost. Furthermore, once per Activation this unit may re-roll a single failed Check if this unit is within 12" of any unit of Civilians.

sharedRules.name: For The Ladies
sharedRules.description: Any model in the unit may add +1 to their Grit, Fight and Mind if they are within 3" of a FEMALE HUMAN model.

sharedRules.name: Gun Down
sharedRules.description: The unit does not suffer the -4 penalty to Aim for Shooting at an Engaged enemy.  Furthermore this unit does not hit a friendly Engaged unit on a Critical Fail when making a Shoot Action against an Engaged enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Bloodthirsty
sharedRules.description: Once per Activation, if this unit wipes out the last model in an enemy unit with a Strike Action this unit gains +1 Fortune Chip (even if they do not have a Fortune value).

sharedRules.name: Murderous
sharedRules.description: While Engaged, each successful Fight or aim Check with a weapon on another Engaged unit causes a further automatic hit on the same unit.  Automatic hits like these (and from qualities like Brutal) cannont generate further hits from the Murderous rule.

sharedRules.name: Team Player
sharedRules.description: This unit may replace its BOSS Train for a FACE Trait.  It loses the Largesse Common Rule and may not take a Posse but may join one as normal.

sharedRules.name: Forward Echelon
sharedRules.description: As long as this unit is within 3" of two or more friendly non-Disordered Hands models, this unit and the Hands models gains +1 Grit.  This unit may Go On Lookout for a cost of one Action Point, regardless of how many Combat Actions it has made that turn.

sharedRules.name: Quick Draw
sharedRules.description: Once per Activation if this unit successfully hits with a Shoot Action, it may make a second Shoot Action at the same or a different target unit for one Action Point rather than the usual two for a repeated Aciton. This second Shoot Action may not be made with weapons with the Heavy or Complex qualities.

sharedRules.name: Gambler
sharedRules.description: When Activated, this unit may discard their Action Card and draw a new Action Card from the deck.  If it does so the new card is applied immediately.  The unit ignores their Action Limit for this Activation.  If the new card is equal to or lower than their original Action Card, then they receive the Stunned Condition and their Activation ends.

sharedRules.name: Dying Breath
sharedRules.description: Should this unit be destroyed it can make a free Combat Action before being removed from the Play Area.

sharedRules.name: Combat Master
sharedRules.description: The unit may make a second Strike Action in an Activation for one Action Point rather than the usual two.  A third or fourth Combat Action still costs two Action Points as normal.

sharedRules.name: Shrewd Strategist
sharedRules.description: Once per turn the unit, when activated, may spend an Action Point to look at the top card from either their Adventure Deck or their Action Deck.  They may discard the card or return it to the top of the deck.

sharedRules.name: Inspirational
sharedRules.description: Any friendly unit (excluding this unit) within 6" may re-roll a single dice roll in their Activation.

sharedRules.name: Treasure Hunter
sharedRules.description: The unit adds +1 to the number of Adventure Cards in the Player's hand.  Should this unit be destroyed, the bonus is lost at the end of the Resolution Phase.  This ability does not stack so multiple Treasure Hunter skills in an amry still only confers +1 to the hand size in total.

sharedRules.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
sharedRules.description: Modesl in this unit gains +1 Grit while in base contact with each other or another friendly model with this rule.  Models with the Mounted trait may not benefit from this rule.

sharedRules.name: Rebel Yell
sharedRules.description: This is a Special Combat Action.  Once this Action has been made by this unit, any other units with the HUMAN and CONFEDERATE Traits gain +1 to their Limit Attribute for the duration of this turn while within 8" of this unit.  This does not stack with any other Limit bonuses.

sharedRules.name: Counter Intelligence
sharedRules.description: Once both sides have deployed and Trailfinder moves have been made, in initiative order the players take it in turns to redeploy any units with this rule in their deployment zone.

sharedRules.name: Masked
sharedRules.description: The unit ignores the Disorder effects of the Smokescreen weapon quality.

sharedRules.name: Indomitable
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when the unit is declared as an initial target of an attack, the unit can take a Mind check, if passed, may remove all Negative Conditions that are applied to it at that time.  If failed, the conditions apply as normal.

sharedRules.name: Tactical Brilliance
sharedRules.description: This unit gains +1 to Reserve Checks using its Mind Attribute.  Oncer per turn the unit, when Activated, may spend two Action Points to look at the top three cards from either their Adventure Deck or their Action Deck and replace them in any order on the top of that deck.

sharedRules.name: Xenoshield
sharedRules.description: The unit may ignore the first point of Piercing from attacks by Ranged Weapons.  Weapons with a Piercing of -4 or greater ignore the Xenoshield Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: Meat Shields
sharedRules.description: When this unit fails a Grit Check, you can pick a friendly model within 3" of this unit to fail their Grit Check instead as they are pulled in front at the last minute, ignorantly sacrificing themselves in the process. Models affected by Meat Shields cannot benefit from the Sawbones Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: Regular Unit
sharedRules.description: A single model in the unit may replace a Ranged Weapon with a weapon from the Special Issue section of their Faction Armoury at the indicated points cost.

sharedRules.name: Special Issue
sharedRules.description: Any model in the unit may replace a Ranged Weapon with a weapon from the Special Issue section of their Faction Armoury at the indicated points cost.

sharedRules.name: Rabble Rouser
sharedRules.description: This unit's army may always include an additional Angry Mob Strategic unit for the appropriate points costs

sharedRules.name: Portal Mastery
sharedRules.description: This unit has technology or the innate ability to create or collapse portals.  This unit may make a Manipulate Portal Action for free each Activation.

sharedRules.name: Invigorate
sharedRules.description: During this unit's Activation, spend an Action Point to nominate a friendly uni in Line of sight within 12".  That nominated unit gains a +1 modifier to their Limit this turn.

sharedRules.name: Compel
sharedRules.description: For two Action Points this unit may select a target unit (friend or foe) within 8".  That targeted unit must make a Mind Check.  If the Check is passed nothing happens.  If the Check fails, the selected unit is Compelled and must immediately make an Action of this unit's choice.  The Action counts as a Free Action, cannot be Focused or use fortunte and for the duration of this Action, the Compelled unit coutsd as friendly to this unit.

sharedRules.name: Fateweaver
sharedRules.description: Once per turn the unit, when Activated, may spend two Action Points to look at the top three cards from their opponent's Adventure Deck or their opponent's Action Deck and shuffle them into any order and replace them on top of that deck.

sharedRules.name: Creation
sharedRules.description: This unit may spend an additional Action Point to double the Piercing value of a single Strike Action. Furthermore, unless hit by a weapon with a Piercing of -4 or greater, the unit may ignore the first point of Piercing from an attack.

sharedRules.name: Failsafe Detonator
sharedRules.description: Should this unit use a weapon with the Suicide quality, it automatically passes any Aim Checks against its Initial Target.

sharedRules.name: Spirit Aim
sharedRules.description: The unit may choose to use their Mind Attribute in place of their Aim Attribute.  Aim Checks made using the Mind Attribute do not suffer Obscured pentalties (but the target still gains a bonus to their Grit Check as normal).

sharedRules.name: Trapper
sharedRules.description: This unit's army may always include an additional Booby Trap Strategic unit for the appropriate points cost. Furthermore this unit ignores the Triggered Detonation rule.

sharedRules.name: Mutual Destruction
sharedRules.description: When this model is destroyed, centre a Blast Template on this model before removing it from the Play Area.  All models touched by the template, friend or foe, suffer a Piercing -1 hit with the Hazardous Special Rule.

sharedRules.name: Controlled Scatter
sharedRules.description: The unit may determine the direction of any scatter in any Action they make.

sharedRules.name: Inexperienced
sharedRules.description: Each time the unit becomes Disordered one model in the unit suffers an automatic Wound.

sharedRules.name: Volatile
sharedRules.description: If this model is wounded it is remove and a Blast template is centred on their former position. All models under the template are hit automatically with a Piercing -1.

sharedRules.name: Experienced Unit
sharedRules.description: A model in the unit may replace a Ranged Weapon with a weapon from the Special Issue section of their Faction Armoury at the indicated points cost.  If the unit is at maximum unit size, a second model may then replace a Ranged Weapon with a weapon from the Special Issue section of their Faction Armoury at the indicated points cost.

sharedRules.name: Forceful Strike
sharedRules.description: Once during its Activation, this unit may spend 1 Action Point to double the Piercing value of a single Strike Action to a maximum of -6.

sharedRules.name: Frenzy
sharedRules.description: For each Critical Success this model rolls during a Fight Check, this model may make a Free Strike Action.  This Free Strike Action is still subject to Frenzy.

sharedRules.name: Loyal Companion
sharedRules.description: This unit may only make Combat Actions with weapons with the Special quality if it is within 4" of the Boss of the Posse.  Furthermore, while this unit is within 4" of the Boss of the Posse, should that Boss be nominated as the Initial Target of an attack, this unit instead becomes the Initial Target of the attack as they dive in front of the bullet, or push their master aside at the last minute, nombly sacrificing themselves in the process.  Calculate range, Line of Sight and cover bonuses etc to the Boss but resolve the Grit Check on this unit instead.

sharedRules.name: Repair
sharedRules.description: Any STRUCTURE, ARTEFACT or friendly MACHINE or CONSTRUCT unit (excluding this unit) withing 3" gains the Tough common rule.

sharedRules.name: Rejuvenate
sharedRules.description: For one Action point this unit may select a friendly unit in Line of Sight and within 12". The selected unit immediately regains d5 Fortune Chips up to its starting value.

sharedRules.name: Underboss
sharedRules.description: This unit may replace its FACE Trait for a BOSS Trait for +45 points.  It not logner counts as a Face unit and gains +1 Fortune and the Largesse Common Rule.  As a Boss it may take a Faction Posse as normal.  If a Theme Posse is available for it, then this unit may take its Theme Posse instead.

sharedRules.name: Tinman
sharedRules.description: Models in this unit gain +1 Grit while in base contact with each other or another friendly model with this rule.  Furthermore, this unit may ignore the penalties for Uneven Ground and may re-roll failed Yeller Checks.

sharedRules.name: Dead or Alive
sharedRules.description: When Engaged with a Stunned or Disordered enemy model, this unit gains the Lethal weapon quality on all Melee weapons.

sharedRules.name: Undercover
sharedRules.description: The unit may be held in Reserve.  Once deployed it moves on from your opponent's deployment table edge.  You must deploy at least 3" from an enemny unit and cannot deploy into a building or transport.

sharedRules.name: Sic 'Em
sharedRules.description: This unit's Posse may include a unit of K9 AUTOMATA for the appropriate points cost.  These are considered to occupy the same Posse slot as this unit.  A unit of K9 Automata within 3" of this model at the end of this model's Activation gain the Teamwork Special Rule for that turn.  For one Action Point this unit may nominate  an enemy unit within 18".  The weapons of any friendly K9 AUTOMATA unit may Focus for free their Shoot and Strike Actions this turn against that targeted unit.

sharedRules.name: Split Personality
sharedRules.description: When Activated, the unit must discard their Action Card and draw a new action Card from the deck.  The new card is applied immediately.

sharedRules.name: Unexpected Arrival
sharedRules.description: When this unit is place in the Play Area, the controlling player must first place a model from the unit at least 6" away from any edge of the Play Area, unit, or impassable terrain feature.  The model scatters d5 inches in a random direction.  The remaining models in the deploying unit must be placed within 3" of that first model.  Any model that cannot be placed at least 1" from any edge of the Play Area, unit, or impassable terrain feature is destroyed (no Grit Check required).  Should the unit be deployed within a building or similar structure it must then me moved the minimum distance possible so that it is finally placed in base contact outside of the building.

sharedRules.name: Impervious
sharedRules.description: This unit ignores negative Piercing modifiers when taking Grit Checks.

sharedRules.name: Dispersed Deployment
sharedRules.description: This unit cannot be placed into Reserve.  After standard deployment, but before any Trailfinder units have deployed, starting with Player B, each player must take it in turns to place a unit with the Dispersed Deployment rule onto the Play Area.  Units must be placed at least 6" apart from another unit and 6" away from any edge of the Play Area and must be placed outside of the deployment zones.

sharedRules.name: Kill Shot
sharedRules.description: Human Inital Targets must re-roll successful Grit checks again Shoot Actions from this model.

sharedRules.name: Bunker
sharedRules.description: After activation, provided this model does not make a Move Action, it gains _2 Grit for the remainder of the turn.

sharedRules.name: Capacity (6)
sharedRules.description: This unit may transport up to six small based models. Units transported in this manner gain the Hunkered condition.  Friendly units can be deployed already mounted in this unit.  Both units are deployed to the battlefield as a single deployment and the transported unit are considered to be mounted.  You cannot put a unit wuth Capacity inside this unit.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle
sharedRules.description: A unit with the VEHICLE trait may fire all of the weapons they are requipped with in the same Shoot Action.  They may target different units with different weapons if they have them.

sharedRules.name: Capacity (10)
sharedRules.description: This unit may transport up to ten small based models. Units transported in this manner gain the Hunkered condition.  Friendly units can be deployed already mounted in this unit.  Both units are deployed to the battlefield as a single deployment and the transported unit are considered to be mounted.  You cannot put a unit wuth Capacity inside this unit.

sharedRules.name: Firing Platform
sharedRules.description: Transported units may make Shoot Actions when Activated but suffer a -2 Aim penalty and may not use weapons with the Heavy quality.  Line of Sight is from the base of the transport model.

sharedRules.name: Fickle
sharedRules.description: This unit must Focus their Combat Action if it is made with a weapon with the Special, Complex, or Heavy qualities.

sharedRules.name: Shield Aura
sharedRules.description: At the start of this unit's Activation it may spend 1 Action Point to gain +1 Grit for the remainder of the turn.

sharedRules.name: Bullrush
sharedRules.description: This unit can Focus Charge Actions for no additional cost. Free Strike Actions do not benefit from this rule.

sharedRules.name: Leeched Ability
sharedRules.description: Whenever this unit successfully destroys an enemy unit, this unit may select an Attribute from the destroyed unit's card.  This selected Attribute replaces the same Attribute on this unit for the remainder of the game. This unit may only have a single Attribute replaced using this rule. If another Attribute is later changed using this rule, the previous change is lost.

sharedRules.name: Bloody Espinosa
sharedRules.description: After both sides have deployed, this unit and an OUTLAWS Hands unit within 3" gain the Trailfinder Special Rule.  As long as this unit is within 3" of two or more friendly ESPINOSA models, this unit gains +1 Grit. This unit may Go On Lookout for a cost of one Action Point, regardless of how many Combat Actions it has made that turn.

sharedRules.name: For The Boys
sharedRules.description: Any model in the unit may add +1 to their Grit, Fight and Mind if they are within 3" of a MALE HUMAN model (excluding models in this unit).

sharedRules.name: Soul Strike
sharedRules.description: This unit cannot be made to re-roll successful Aim or Fight Checks in Combat Actions

sharedRules.name: Arcane
sharedRules.description: During its Activation, this unit may spend 1 Action Point and may use its Mind Attribute in place of any other Attribute (except Limit) for any Check.  All modifiers to the Check are still applied unless they specifically refer to the replaced Attribute.  Arcane lasts until the end of that Activation.

sharedRules.name: Sky-Leap
sharedRules.description: This unit may make a Sky-Leap Special Move Action.  Units making a Sky-Leap may be placed up to 9" from its position at the start of the Action. Ignore any terrain restrictions on the movement but the unit must not end their Sky-Leap in impassable terrain or Engaged in combat. You cannot Focus a Sky-Leap Action.

sharedRules.name: Berserker
sharedRules.description: After the first game turn, when the unit Activates it must pass a Mind check to Activate as normal.  If it fails, the unit must try to Engage the closest enemy unit within 18" and Line of Sight.  When making a Walk, Ram or Charge Action the unit must always travel by the shortest route possible to that nominated unit.

sharedRules.name: Portal Model
sharedRules.description: This counts as a Portal model for the purposes of Portal Manipulation.

sharedRules.name: Insignificant
sharedRules.description: This unit may never be Activated, may never count as a friendly unit and its destruction never awards Victory Points unless specified in the Adventure.

sharedRules.name: Node of Power
sharedRules.description: This unit regains Fortune Chips up to its starting value at the start of each Resolution Phase. Furthermore this unit may allow a friendly unit within 12" to spend Fortune Chips from this unit as though they were their own.

sharedRules.name: Path of Yi
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when this unit fails a Grit Check, you can pick a friendly or enemy HAND or SUPPORT model within 3" of this unit to fail their Grit Check instead.

sharedRules.name: Galvanic
sharedRules.description: The Stun and Disrupt Qualities do not cause Attribute penalties to be suffered by this unit, though they still count as having the Condition.

sharedRules.name: Gene Link
sharedRules.description: At the start of their Activation, a unit with this rule may duplicate any one Special Rule acquired through the Leeched Ability Special Rule from a friendly unit with the Leeched Ability Special Rule within 12".

sharedRules.name: Ghost Armour
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when hit from a Combat Action, this unit may make an unmodified Mind Check.  If successful the unit may use their Mind Attribute in place of their Grit Attribute for the remainder of the turn.

characteristics.$text: Revolver Fan, Ammo Clip, Close Work
